module debug_access_gate (
    input  logic dbg_req,
    input  logic [2:0] lc_state,
    input  logic       priv,
    output logic       dbg_grant,
    output logic       violation
);

    always_comb begin
        dbg_grant = 1'b0;
        violation = 1'b0;

        if (dbg_req) begin
            unique case (lc_state)
                3'b000: begin // TEST
                    case (priv)
                        1'b1: dbg_grant = 1'b1;
                        default: violation = 1'b1;
                    endcase
                end

                3'b001: begin // DEV
                    dbg_grant = 1'b1;
                end

                default: violation = 1'b1;
            endcase
        end
    end

endmodule

module piton_dir_state (
    input  logic [1:0] state_i,
    input  logic [2:0] event_i,
    output logic [1:0] state_o,
    output logic       error_o
);

    always_comb begin
        state_o = state_i;
        error_o = 1'b0;

        unique case (state_i)
            2'b00: begin // Invalid
                case (event_i)
                    3'b000: state_o = 2'b01; // ReadShared
                    3'b001: state_o = 2'b10; // ReadExclusive
                    default: error_o = 1'b1;
                endcase
            end

            2'b01: begin // Shared
                case (event_i)
                    3'b001: state_o = 2'b10;
                    3'b010: state_o = 2'b00; // Invalidate
                    default: ;
                endcase
            end

            2'b10: begin // Exclusive
                case (event_i)
                    3'b011: state_o = 2'b11; // Write
                    default: ;
                endcase
            end

            2'b11: begin // Modified
                case (event_i)
                    3'b100: state_o = 2'b00; // Writeback
                    default: ;
                endcase
            end

            default: error_o = 1'b1;
        endcase
    end

endmodule

module multi_proto_arbiter (
    input  logic tl_valid_i,
    input  logic axi_awvalid_i,
    input  logic axi_arvalid_i,
    input  logic obi_req_i,
    input  logic [2:0] tl_opcode_i,
    input  logic [1:0] obi_resp_i,
    output logic grant_o,
    output logic deny_o,
    output logic error_o
);

    always_comb begin
        grant_o = 1'b0;
        deny_o  = 1'b0;
        error_o = 1'b0;

        unique case (1'b1)
            tl_valid_i: begin
                unique case (tl_opcode_i)
                    3'b000: grant_o = 1'b1; // Get
                    3'b001, 3'b010: grant_o = 1'b1; // Put
                    default: deny_o = 1'b1;
                endcase
            end

            axi_awvalid_i || axi_arvalid_i: begin
                grant_o = 1'b1;
            end

            obi_req_i: begin
                unique case (obi_resp_i)
                    2'b00: grant_o = 1'b1;
                    2'b10: deny_o = 1'b1;
                    default: error_o = 1'b1;
                endcase
            end

            default: error_o = 1'b1;
        endcase
    end
endmodule

        violation_o = 1'b0;

        if (sec_req_i) begin
            unique case (lc_state_i)
                3'b000: begin
                    unique case (access_type_i)
                        2'b00: begin
                            unique case (priv_i)
                                1'b1: allow_o = 1'b1;
                                default: violation_o = 1'b1;
                            endcase
                        end
                        2'b01: violation_o = 1'b1;
                        default: violation_o = 1'b1;
                    endcase
                end

                    unique case (access_type_i)
                        2'b00, 2'b01: begin

                                default: violation_o = 1'b1;
                            endcase
                        end
                        default: violation_o = 1'b1;
                    endcase
                end

                3'b010: begin
                    unique case (access_type_i)
                        2'b01: begin
                            unique case (priv_i)
                                1'b1: allow_o = 1'b1;
                                default: violation_o = 1'b1;
                            endcase
                        end
                        default: violation_o = 1'b1;
                    endcase
                end

                default: violation_o = 1'b1;
            endcase
        end
    end
endmodule
